_note: The Crown (Level 100): nine bronze bells on the Mentor's Tower crown, where no stair goes. On a night of wind each bell answers only a mage who has heard its Warden's ring somewhere in the world - by a deed or a teaching she really has (any one of the keys in `any`). All nine together: crown:heard_all_nine. See docs/THE_CROWN.md.
